description: Official plugins released through their own tag series and listed in index.json. A plugin is released when its packageDirectory changes and its plugin.json version has no tag yet; changing the directory without a new version fails CI.

index.name: PHP Support
index.author: Lithe
index.description: PHP language intelligence through the bundled Intelephense language server, plus running PHP files and PHPUnit tests. Requires Node.js and PHP on this Mac.

localizedDescriptions.zh-Hans: 通过内置的 Intelephense 语言服务器提供 PHP 代码智能，并支持运行 PHP 文件和 PHPUnit 测试。需要本机已安装 Node.js 和 PHP。
